subject: 🐋 Still here for the days between sessions
preview: A short reminder of what MindSync does, and how to see what's new.
h1_bold: Here's what MindSync is for, in short.

blocks.alt: Illustration: an orca tail rising over waves in front of a coral sun

blocks.text: Before therapy gives you a one-page card with a short summary of what came up since last time and up to three numbered questions to bring.

blocks.alt: Three MindSync screens: the Before therapy card with numbered questions, the After therapy card with the progress chart, and Timeline

blocks.text: Note what you took away while it's fresh. After three sessions, the After therapy card adds Your progress in therapy, a chart of your own entries. It doesn't grade your mental health or your therapist.
Talk things through with Orca in Reflect. Orca isn't a therapist and doesn't replace yours. You can read every note it keeps about you in Settings, and delete any of them.
We update MindSync often. Update it in the App Store or Google Play to see what's new since your last visit.
This is our last check-in about coming back. After this, you'll only hear from us now and then, with a newsletter or a big app update, and you can switch that off below too.

footer_promise: We promise to only send you mental health-related tips & updates.

footer_image.alt: Illustration: a lighthouse on a cliff, a sailboat and a coral sun

crisis_line: MindSync isn't a crisis service. If you're in crisis, call or text 988 in the US, or find a local helpline at findahelpline.com.
